change_note: Signatures, pass keys, input schemas and every result schema string are identical to the checkpoint candidate (sha256 11fe9b6c...). Acceptance is STRICTER (see added_checks) and some result fields were ADDED (manifest_admission, exit_code_equals_requested_code). An adapter that already passes the control-survival and record audits on real records is unaffected unless a record contradicts an added check. Semantic identity is the sha256 of raw_audit.py in freeze.json, not the schema string.
imports: Python standard library only: datetime, hashlib, json, pathlib.PureWindowsPath, re. No product/common predicate, no native/GUI/process/Job/FFI call, no filesystem access. Callers pass already-parsed JSON dicts; the functions never mutate them (digest before/after is enforced).

expected_required.argv: EXACT native argv list of strings; argv0 absolute selected native image
expected_required.working_directory: absolute Windows cwd compared with PureWindowsPath; no filesystem normalization/query
expected_required.executable_sha256: expected actual selected executable SHA256 (64 lowercase hex)

expected_optional.run_id: exact public UUID if prospectively captured; omit otherwise

audit_record.pass_criterion: audit_state==qualified_full_lifetime_close AND lifetime_passed is True AND actual_job_close_passed is True AND collector_close_passed is True. This does not assert correct public state, killed members, physics or new runtime admission.
output_added: members[].exit_code_equals_requested_code (forced records only; observation, never attribution)
audit_record.members: All original retained members, never only job_pids_before: identity/image/role/capture provenance/exit proof/pre_request_category live_before_request or early_exited_before_request or not_applicable; live is an observation not causal kill proof.

manifest_admission.schema_version: record.schema_version must be the int 3 (not bool/float/str)
manifest_admission.terminal_state: record.state must be one of TERMINAL_STATES; running/stopping/owner_lost/unknown refuse
manifest_admission.json_protocol: NOT checked: the manifest carries no protocol field (protocol 2 is the CLI stdout envelope). Reported as json_protocol_checked=false.
manifest_admission.nested_versions: job_close.schema_version, termination_request.schema_version, member_trace.schema_version were already exact (1); short_lifecycle.schema_version (2) is a product verdict and is NOT consulted

added_checks: manifest schema_version==3, terminal public state, original launch-HANDLE identity source
created_at_utc <= started_at_utc <= finished_at_utc; created_at_utc <= original Job associated_at_utc
ownership.initial_job_pids contains the root and only PIDs of the original lifetime roster
forced: public stop_reason (when present) equals the actual TerminateJobObject request reason
forced: every pre-request observation (member, root_handle, auxiliary) is not earlier than the same original HANDLE capture
forced: pre_request state unavailable requires a raw error dict; state captured must not carry one
forced: optional exit_image_query is advisory; unavailable needs an error and no image; captured needs an image equal to the original capture; never coverage

forced: member, root_handle and auxiliary exit observations share one exit primitive check (state/wait/GetExitCodeProcess return/confirmed/wait_timeout_ms); auxiliary and root exit codes equal the original; auxiliary and root exit checks are not earlier than the request return
audit_record.forced_schema: Original227 force schema has no serialized full notification trace. Full original HANDLE capture+identity+image+membership, exact final originalJob TotalProcesses=count, each exit+empty Job and real close are independently required. If any trace is supplied it is fully checked and cannot be ignored. Missing exported trace is reported as notification_evidence=not_exported_in_original_forced_schema, never synthesized. Raw false prospective summary is retained, not an independent evidence substitute.
limits: Closure is not a causal kill, clean native finalization, numerical completion or public-state verdict.
Individual member CloseHandle integer returns are not exported by the original records and are not invented.
Equal timestamps across handles of one process cannot order a live/signalled pair and are accepted; only strictly ordered signalled-then-live is refused.
The 'captured' shape of exit_image_query never occurs in the five originals; its check is the conservative reading, not observed behaviour.
Public created/started/finished and association ordering is supported by the five originals and the launch order, not by exhaustive product-code proof.

expectation_optional.control_terminal_states: predeclared allowed state list for controlled disposal; default [completed]; subset of completed|cancelled|timed_out|failed. The caller owns the declaration (an adapter may narrow it to [cancelled]); the reader does not widen it.

assert_public_state.pass_criterion: passed is True AND case_success is True. A natural race returns passed True, case_success False, natural_race_observed True (stop NOT exercised).
assert_public_state.purpose: Public-state assertions separate from lifetime audit. Natural races retain completed/failed state and stop_achieved=False; never label forced completed or promote historical cleanup_failed.

observations_required: target_case_id (== final component of target run_directory)
audit_control_survival.pass_criterion: audit_state==independent_control_survival_confirmed AND passed is True AND control_lifetime_passed is True AND observer_same_handle_confirmed is True. No original HANDLE membership/coverage is borrowed from the observer. A missed live/exited window returns audit_state=not_observed, passed False.

snapshot_schema.observer_id: UUID (32 hex or hyphenated) added by the adapter's Observer subclass and fixed to the SAME independently opened QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE HANDLE object; NOT the native Popen handle
snapshot_schema.state: the pinned source maps actual WaitForSingleObject WAIT_TIMEOUT(258) to live and WAIT_OBJECT_0 to exited, anything else to unavailable; the raw integer is not exported and is NEVER synthesized
snapshot_schema.in_a_job: actual IsProcessInJob(handle, NULL) ANY-Job result (bool, or null when the call failed). It is a sanity condition on LIVE samples only (must be true). It is NOT exact private-Job membership proof; exited samples need no value.
snapshot_schema.image: capture-time resolved path of the same HANDLE (label image_observation=capture_time_image_NOT_post_exit_query); compared with PureWindowsPath equality (case-insensitive)
snapshot_schema.clocks: observed_at_utc (timezone-aware ISO-8601) and monotonic_ns (time.monotonic_ns) are stamped by one process from two clocks
snapshot_schema.optional_labels: If present, handle_role, image_observation, membership_scope (and the legacy handle_relation) must equal the pinned strings in OBSERVER_LABELS; any contradicting claim (native Popen, post-exit query, exact private Job) refuses. Absent labels are tolerated.

close_schema.wrapper: EXACT key set {final_snapshot, close} (what the adapter's close_observer() returns). Extra or missing keys refuse.
close_schema.final_snapshot: a snapshot (same schema) taken by the adapter at close time; must be state exited for the same observer_id/birth/image/source

close.handle_source: optional; when present must equal source
close.identity: {pid, creation_time_100ns} equal to the captured birth
close.return_value: actual nonzero int kernel result, not bool
close.succeeded: true; a failed close carries error and no return_value and refuses
close.started_at_utc / finished_at_utc / obser: adapter stamps started before the call, finished after return, observed after finished. The reader accepts observed_at_utc anywhere at or after final_snapshot time (post-call is the real shape; pre-call is tolerated without synthesizing anything). started<=finished and final_snapshot<=started are required.
close.winerror: absent in the real record; when present must be null

chronology.per_observer: control: control_before -> control_after -> control_pre_cleanup -> control_final -> close.final_snapshot; target: target_before -> target_exit -> close.final_snapshot. For each adjacent pair: UTC non-decreasing; monotonic_ns strictly increasing (equal only when the very same snapshot object is re-presented where allowed: control_after==control_pre_cleanup, and final_snapshot==the preceding exit sample); |delta UTC - delta monotonic| <= SKEW_NS (1 s) else refused as disagreeing clocks.
chronology.cross_observer: Only UTC is compared across observers (live samples before the actual target trigger, control_after after the actual original target close, control_pre_cleanup before the control's own stop request, control_final after the control's original close). Monotonic values are never compared across observers.
chronology.missing_window: A required live or exited sample whose state differs is NOT_OBSERVED and never a pass.

proof_joins: control_before/control_after/control_pre_cleanup all LIVE, SAME observer_id/birth/image; the live-captured independent handle is retained across samples
target_before LIVE and target_exit EXITED, same target observer joined by birth/image to the original target owner
control_final EXITED, same control observer joined to the control's whole-lifetime original owner audit (audit_record on the control record must itself qualify)
distinct run_id/run_directory/private-Job tokens and original births; same route, selected executable image and executable_sha256
any-Job query is auxiliary; private-Job truth comes only from the original-owner audit
each observer's CloseHandle raw return is required once per actual object; no borrowed root/Job cleanup claim
observer UTC/monotonic chronology bounds the target actual stop/terminal and the control's own cleanup

rules: No product/CLI/common predicates imported or invoked
No engine/PID/GUI/process queries; pure JSON records only
No raw-record mutation or synthesized flags

Active snapshots are not atomic with later per-HANDLE observations; roster equality with the live subset is NOT required; unknown/missing members or irreversibly signalled->live strictly ordered contradictions refuse
Root_handle/request-root snapshots are auxiliary observations, never replacements for full retained-member capture
Actual TerminateJobObject and CloseHandle return int/nonzero, not bool; the collector close must be original/stopped/error-free/not-borrowed
Natural/failed closure and 600s/restart/numeric outputs are separate from forced lifetime closure (physics_assessed is always false)
All original #227 states/bytes remain immutable; the old active-only classifier scope is not labelled a bug
Producer 12 max / 2 concurrent / one attempt remains the adapter's prospective plan; G review and an exclusive native lease are required and not granted here

supersedes.reason: V1 incorrectly demanded inaccessible original-launch HANDLE and exact-private-Job observations from an outside CLI observer; only the original owner lifetime gate can supply those.
